Welcome to my new Pakistan Travel Vlog!
In this Pakistan Travel Vlog, we continue our journey from Lahore to Sheikhupura, exploring some of the most fascinating historical, cultural, and religious places of Punjab, Pakistan.
We travelled from Lahore towards Sheikhupura via the M2 Motorway, experiencing the roads, local life, food, and everyday atmosphere of Pakistan along the way.
